title: Fundamental Theorem of Discrete Asset Pricing
abstract: arXiv:2610.21442v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Motivated by discrete price quotes in continuous time, we seek a fundamental theorem based on no arbitrage rather than a condition on limiting trading opportunities. We consider a vector of discounted prices taking values in a locally finite subset of $R^d$ in continuous time. For a locally bounded c\`adl\`ag price, we prove that no arbitrage, no free lunch with vanishing risk, no free lunch, and the existence of an equivalent local martingale measure are equivalent. An elementary finite-dimensional reduction of portfolios yields a common pathwise bound on admissible wealth. This bound reduces closedness to convex averaging in a weighted Hilbert space, after which the Kreps-Yan theorem applies. Trading gains are finite Stieltjes sums, and the proof uses no It\^o integration.

translated_title: 离散资产定价基本定理
translated_abstract: 受连续时间中离散价格报价的启发，我们寻求一个基于无套利条件而非限制性交易机会条件的基本定理。我们考虑在连续时间内取值于 $\mathbb{R}^d$ 中局部有限子集的贴现价格向量。对于局部有界的càdlàg价格，我们证明了无套利、无消失风险自由午餐、无自由午餐以及等价局部鞅测度的存在性是相互等价的。通过对投资组合进行初等的有限维约化，得到了可容许财富的一个统一的逐路径界。该界将闭性问题约化为加权希尔伯特空间中的凸平均问题，随后应用Kreps-Yan定理即可完成证明。交易收益表示为有限的Stieltjes和，整个证明过程不使用Itô积分。
tldr: 本文在连续时间离散价格框架下建立了资产定价基本定理，证明了无套利、无消失风险自由午餐、无自由午餐与等价局部鞅测度存在性的等价性，且证明完全避开Itô积分，仅使用有限Stieltjes和。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes a fundamental theorem of asset pricing for discrete price quotes in continuous time, proving the equivalence between no arbitrage, no free lunch with vanishing risk, no free lunch, and the existence of an equivalent local martingale measure, using only finite Stieltjes sums without Itô integration.
